Rubber Band R3 for OUENKA BASE

The browser worker uses rubberband-wasm 3.3.0, including the
Rubber Band Library 3.3.0. This directory includes the upstream npm
package (wrapper sources and build script), the corresponding
Rubber Band Library source archive, and the GPL license text.

Upstream wrapper: https://github.com/Daninet/rubberband-wasm
Upstream library: https://breakfastquay.com/rubberband/
License terms: https://breakfastquay.com/rubberband/license.html

公開配布前に、OUENKA BASE本体と依存ライブラリの配布条件を
確認してください。このZIPには元のアプリのライセンス変更を
含めていません。
